# QBall Design System

> The QBall Design System is a portable, self-contained design system: a locked
> token layer (color, type, spacing, radii, borders, motion) plus a
> framework-agnostic React component layer, shipped in both light and dark from
> the same tokens. It publishes to npm as `@qball-inc/tokens` and
> `@qball-inc/react` (Apache-2.0).

The token layer is drop-in CSS custom properties plus a DTCG / Style-Dictionary
JSON mirror (zero build step). The React layer is thin, accessible className
wrappers over the shipped component CSS — Radix where a primitive needs real
behavior, D3 for charts — with Radix/D3/TanStack as optional peers. Light and
dark are both first-class via `data-theme`. The display face defaults to Fira
Code; the intended Berkeley Mono is restored per-license in private builds. A
live gallery renders every component in light and dark.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): What the system is, how to consume it, the package layout, and the non-negotiables.
- [Live gallery](https://qball-inc.github.io/qball-design-system/): Every component in light + dark, deployed from this repo.
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): The design source of truth — foundations (color, type, layout, elevation, shape, motion, icons, voice) and Do's/Don'ts.

## Packages (npm)

- [@qball-inc/tokens](packages/tokens/): The locked token layer as drop-in CSS + DTCG JSON (zero build step). Subpaths: `./theme.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme`), `./colors-and-type.css`, `./components.css`, `./tokens.json`.
- [@qball-inc/react](packages/react/): The framework-agnostic component layer as a React library (dual ESM/CJS + types). Token-driven.
- [docs/consumer-setup.md](docs/consumer-setup.md): How to install and wire the packages in a consumer app.
- [docs/consumer-handback.md](docs/consumer-handback.md): Peer dependencies, the theme mechanism, and the SSR island matrix for consumers.
- [docs/font-override.md](docs/font-override.md): Restoring Berkeley Mono in a licensed consumer build.

## Component specimens & design specs

- [preview/](preview/): One live HTML card per component — the canonical state matrices the gallery is built from.

- [docs/tool-use-indicator-design.md](docs/tool-use-indicator-design.md): The AI tool-use / skill indicator design.
